messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: METERING ALERT: downstream emitter latency > 2m for multiple shards, delayed usage emits and excess overage flags observed. Count drift detected vs. shadow ledger. Pager sent to #incidents.

oncall-bot: summary: delayed emits -> customers seeing late usage + transient overage email triggers. Affected region: eu-west-1, models: text-gen-3a variants.

emily: I'm on it, pulling emitter logs now. tagging @raj for proxy/ingest side.

raj: looking at emitter queue metrics — there's a backlog on commit-worker-3. `commit_latency_p50` jumped to 120s at 12:04 UTC.

michael: confirming billing telemetry shows a gap between token-emits and ledger ingestion starting ~11:58 UTC. Some clients received overage flags due to delayed reconciliation.

emily: stack traces show repeated 504 from proxy to emitter during retries. suspect networking flap after a small deploy to the emitter autoscaler.

raj: rolling proxy restart on shard-3 (one at a time) to drain retries. doing canary now.

ops-lead: do we need to suppress customer overage alerts? @sara-billing can you advise?

sara-billing: yes please. Turning off automated overage emails for impacted customers for the next 45m. Will annotate tickets and send a calm email after we reconcile.

emily: canaries look clean for shard-3 after restart. commit latency down to ~15s. Will keep monitoring.

raj: found root cause — a new circuit breaker in the autoscaler was tripping too aggressively under burst. Reverting the autoscaler flag now: `--cb-threshold=0.8 -> 0.95`.

emily: revert applied. emitter backfills started for the backlog. launching a corrective re-emit job: `tools/reemit --since=2026-03-16T11:50Z --target=shadow-ledger`

michael: estimate of customer impact: ~0.5% of daily tokens delayed; ~120 customers got transient overage flags, no charges applied yet. We'll reconcile before billing cycle.

ops-lead: action items: 1) keep alert suppression until reconciliation complete 2) run full reconcile job and verify token parity 3) send postmortem + customer notes 4) add autoscaler test for burst behavior.

raj: reconcile job started. sample verification output:```
verified_shard_3: expected=1,234,567 emitted=1,234,567 reconciled=true
verified_shard_7: expected=987,654 emitted=987,652 reconciled=false (2-token diff)
```

emily: small diffs possible due to dedupe window; tracking any >100 token mismatches. so far none.

sara-billing: I'll hold refunds/credits until final ledger match. drafting customer notification template now.

michael: monitoring dashboard shows metrics returning to baseline. marking incident "mitigated" in pager and starting handoff to oncall for reconciliation window.

oncall-bot: Incident 6901234567 status: MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Please add any follow-ups to the ticket: INF-2026-342.

ops-lead: good triage. Emily/raj please own the postmortem and include timeline + autoscaler regression test. Sara please coordinate customer comms. Closing live channel in 30m unless new anomalies. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
